name: fleet-publish-preflight-resolution
title: Fleet publish resolves the completion-receipt preflight from the consumer, not the pack
description: fleet-publish.py resolves the review preflight with a bare consumer-relative path under cwd=consumer. No thin consumer vendors scripts/, so the completion receipt reads empty stdout and pr-publication fails for every fleet lane. Resolve it from the running script directory, matching the --record-session precedent in the same file.
creator: sdelmas
